statement: The verdict is accurate: Foreloop does not publish an llms.txt file or an agent-oriented docs endpoint today. Our docs at foreloop.com/docs are written for humans, and the MCP server (/api/app/public/v1/mcp) plus the CLI's --json output are currently the only agent-facing surfaces. An llms.txt index of the docs is on our roadmap; we are not requesting any change to this verdict and will submit new evidence through the normal contest/re-judge flow once it ships.
contactRole: Founder, Ultrametric (Foreloop's vendor, which also operates this site)

verification.evidence: Committed by a github.com/ultrametricai org maintainer in this repository — Foreloop and Ultrametric share the ultrametricai GitHub org
